Ethereum Warms Up in the US Market: Are Signals of Capital Returning Here?

Recently, the sentiment around Ethereum in the US market has quietly warmed up—although not rapidly, signs of recovery are already visible.

First, let's look at the data: the "Quality Index" measuring US investor interest has risen from -0.12 last Thursday to -0.02; although it is still negative, it indicates that US buyers' valuation of Bitcoin is slightly higher than before. The Ethereum ETF has also ended eight consecutive days of outflows, with a net inflow of $96.67 million on Monday, marking the second consecutive day of positive growth—while this isn't considered "bursting with heat," steady growth is often a precursor to market recovery.

The actions of large funds are more direct: whales holding 10,000-100,000 ETH have increased their holdings by about 440,000 in the past week, clearly aiming to push the price back above the cost line. However, medium and small wallets (holding 100-10,000 ETH) have reduced their holdings by about 220,000, indicating that market confidence has not fully returned and attitudes remain cautious.

The futures market also shows signs of "testing": in the past week, Ethereum futures experienced a net outflow of $4.31 billion (with leverage decreasing), but in the last three days, $735 million has flowed in, as traders begin to cautiously test the waters—this is related to the soaring expectations of interest rate cuts by the Federal Reserve (the probability of a rate cut in December has risen from 30% to over 80%), which usually boosts the sentiment for risk assets.

Currently, the price is stuck at the $3,000 mark: $2,850 has support, and if it can break through $3,100 (close to the 20-day moving average resistance), it may test the upper boundary of the descending channel; if it falls below $2,850, we'll need to watch the support at the lower boundary of the channel. The RSI and stochastic indicators are slowly rising, but have not yet reached neutral levels; bearish momentum is weakening, but it has not completely disappeared.

In summary: the sentiment in the US market towards Ethereum has shifted from "cold" to "warm"; whales and ETFs are entering the market, but smaller funds are still on the sidelines. It is now a "bottom testing period," and whether it can stabilize depends on whether it can hold above $3,000.

title: Trump's Fed Bet Puts Kevin Hassett in Line for Fed Chair

$BTC  and Crypto wave incoming? Trump-era adviser Kevin Hassett, a Coinbase shareholder, is the front-runner to replace Powell as Fed Chair. Putting a 'crypto-friendly' dovish dove in control of U.S. monetary policy could change everything.
Context in a Nutshell
In a move that could reshape Wall Street and the crypto industry, Trump's top economic adviser, Kevin Hassett, is reportedly the front-runner to lead the Fed. With deep crypto ties and a commitment to aggressive rate cuts, his selection could turbo-charge risk assets, including digital tokens, while redrawing monetary policy.
What You Should Know
Kevin Hassett, a long-time economic adviser to Donald Trump and current head of the National Economic Council (NEC), has reportedly emerged as the top candidate to become the next Chair of the Federal Reserve when current Chair Jerome Powell's term ends in May 2026.
Hassett is widely viewed as "crypto-friendly": he oversaw the NEC's "digital asset working group" and, in 2025, disclosed owning a substantial stake (anywhere between one and five million USD) in Coinbase Global, an American crypto exchange. Besides, he served on Coinbase's Academic & Regulatory Advisory Council.
On monetary policy, Hassett has repeatedly signalled that he supports faster and deeper interest-rate cuts than the current Fed tone suggests, a stance aligned with Trump's long-standing criticism of what he sees as overly tight monetary policy under Powell.
If confirmed, Hassett's appointment could mark a major pivot in how the Fed approaches both crypto and macro liquidity, possibly opening the door to looser monetary policy, more favorable regulation for digital assets, and renewed risk-asset inflows.
Why Does This Matter?
If a crypto-tied insider like Hassett takes the Fed helm, the implications ripple far beyond DC. Easier access to capital and a regulatory ear could reignite institutional flows into digital assets. For crypto strategists, it could mark a turning point, from survival mode to structural adoption. For macro watchers, it signals a possible reset in the U.S. monetary regime, which will touch equities, bonds, inflation expectations, and global capital flows.
With the Fed chair race heating up, the next few months may decide more than just rates; they could shape how crypto is woven into the global financial fabric. Watch this space.

At 3 AM Beijing time on November 28, the Federal Reserve will release its periodic Beige Book on economic conditions. Although this report does not directly dictate policy, it significantly influences market expectations regarding the future direction of Federal Reserve policies, which in turn can trigger short-term fluctuations in global assets such as foreign exchange, bonds, stock markets, and even the cryptocurrency market, making it highly anticipated.

The importance of the Beige Book lies in its role as an internal reference for the Federal Reserve's decision-making. It is compiled about two weeks before each monetary policy meeting, aggregating anonymous survey information collected from 12 regional Federal Reserve banks, reflecting the real state of the U.S. economy and covering various aspects including employment, inflation, consumption, and manufacturing. Unlike hard data such as CPI and non-farm payrolls, it provides qualitative, insightful perspectives that reveal the real conditions behind the data, including business activity, consumer confidence, and price pressures, serving as a key soft basis for Federal Reserve officials' data-driven decisions.

The impact pathway of the Beige Book on the market is clear. If the report shows a significant economic slowdown or signs of recession, the market will believe that the economy needs support and that inflation threats are diminishing, thereby reinforcing expectations for rate cuts. The Federal Reserve may stimulate the economy more quickly and earlier, which could be a potential positive for risk assets like cryptocurrencies, possibly driving assets like BTC up.

If the economy is overheating and inflation pressures remain stubborn, the market will perceive the economy as too strong and that inflation needs to be curtailed, subsequently delaying expectations for rate cuts. A higher and longer-lasting interest rate policy will persist, which could be a potential negative for cryptocurrencies, as a high-rate environment will suppress risk assets. If the economy grows moderately and inflation is controllable, the market will view the prospects of a soft landing optimistically, allowing the Federal Reserve to remain patient and hold steady, and the market may continue its existing trend, presenting a neutral to slightly volatile state.

For ordinary players like us, it's important to pay attention to the release time, while focusing on whether the report describes the labor market, consumer spending, and price pressures as strong, moderate, or slowing. 一、牛市是“筛子”，不是“捡钱场”

行情一热，总有人什么火追什么，最后手里一堆赛道，涨没吃到、跌全赶上。

我从来只盯一个方向，新热点出来就扎进去研究透，从团队背景到落地进展，认准了就握紧不放。

真正在牛市赚到大钱的，从来不是啥都懂的杂家，而是一招练到极致的专家。

二、“买新不买旧”，拒绝为情怀买单

总有人说“拿了三年的老项目有感情”，但市场最不缺的就是感情，最值钱的是新故事。

那些躺了很久的老币，多半是跟不上节奏的“旧机器”，偶尔反弹也只是回光返照。别让情怀绑架你的钱包，新逻辑、新生态才是市场真正追逐的焦点。

三、杠杆是工具，不是赌具

我靠杠杆赚过八位数，也因为它三次爆仓。

如果你非用不可，记住三条底线：第一，绝不满仓，留足“救命钱”；

第二，杠杆别超5倍，高杠杆等于玩火；

第三，止损要果断，跌破点位别犹豫。把杠杆当赌具的人，迟早出局。

四、读懂周期，比找到百倍币更重要

加密市场四年一轮回，牛熊交替非常规律。

但总有人在牛市尾声还做着暴富梦，连奶茶店老板都开始问买什么的时候，就该警惕了。

牛市末尾一定要清理那些没实质支撑的小币，否则熊市一来，90%的回撤能让你一夜回到起点。守住利润，靠的是知进退的周期智慧。

说实话，我没什么天赋，也没内幕，能活下来全靠：不贪、不懒、不怕错。

现在总有人问我“哪个币能翻倍”，但我更想反问：如果跌90%，你拿得住吗？

加密圈不是赌场，而是修炼场。行情一直在，机会永远有，但最终能抓住的，永远是那些愿意沉下心来打磨自己的人。

Dear Binance family, I've noticed that most of my Binance family members are Urdu/Hindi speaking & they want to learn about trading but in native language. So from now on, I'll be sharing most of my content in Urdu for you guys, I hope you get most out of it. That being said, let's begin 💜 
So aj mai aap ke saath crypto market ki aik bohat zaroori information share karne wala hun, jise Bitcoin CME Gaps kehte hain. Yeh samjhna aap ki trading analysis mein bohat madad dega.
📉 Bitcoin CME Gap: Ye Kia Hota He?
CME ka matlab hai Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
Simple alfaz mein:
 * CME Gap tab banta hai jab Friday ko jab CME futures market band hoti hai (closing price) aur Monday ko jab khulti hai (opening price), to in dono qeemton mein bohat bara farq aa jaye.
 * Yeh farq is liye aata hai kyunke weekend par CME band hota hai, lekin Binance aur baaqi exchanges par Bitcoin (BTC) ki trading 24/7 chalti rehti hai.
 * Chart par yeh farq aik khali jagah (blank space) ki shakal mein nazar aata hai, jise hum 'Gap' kehte hain.
💰 Ye Gaps Hamare Lye Kyun Zaruri Hain?
Aap soch rahe honge ke CME par kya ho raha hai, humein kyun farq padna chahiye?
 * Bari Machliyan (Big Players): CME regulated market hai aur yahan par institutional investors (bare banks, hedge funds) futures trading karte hain. In ke paas bohat zyada capital hota hai.
 * Jab itna bara paisa kisi price point ko ignore karke aage nikal jaye, to woh point market ka aik weak spot ban jata hai.
Isi liye, trading analysis mein in gaps ko bohat ahmiyat di jati hai.
📊 Traders K Lye Ye Kia Maani Rakhti He?
CME Gaps ki sabse khaas baat ye hai ki in ki tendency hoti hai 'Fill' hone ki.
 * Gap Fill Hoga: Taquiban 98% se zyada gaps der ya sawer fill ho jate hain. Yaani, BTC ki qeemat wapas us khali jagah tak aakar trade karti hai.
 * Support & Resistance: Traders in gaps ko ahem Support aur Resistance zones ki tarah dekhte hain.
   * Agar gap neeche reh gaya hai, to aksar log expect karte hain ke price wahan tak pullback karegi.
   * Agar gap upar reh gaya hai, to woh aik target area ban jata hai.
Lekin Yaad Rakhein!
Gap fill hone mein time lagta hai. Kuch gaps kuch ghanton mein, jab ke kuch ko kai mahine bhi lag sakte hain.
For example: 
November 2024 mein $78,000 aur $80,700 ke darmiyan jo gap bana tha, usay taqreeban chaar mahine (nearly four months) lage the fill hone mein.
Is liye hamesha:
 * Market context ko dekhein.
 * Apna Risk Management hamesha strong rakhein.
 * Sirf gap par depend mat karen, baaqi analysis bhi zaroori hai.
I hope, ye information aapko market ko behtar samjhne mein madad degi! Koi sawal ho to pooch sakte hain.

“Can a few thousand turn into a million?” I give a definite answer based on my personal experience – I have truly walked this thorny path.
At the start, I converted my savings of seven thousand into 1000U, which was all my confidence for a do-or-die situation, with no way back.

I tested the waters with 200U, only chasing the hot coins of the day, withdrawing once I doubled my investment or stopping losses at 50U. Steadily and surely, my principal quickly grew.
The key to trading is controlling the impulse of getting "high". Several times when I just made over a thousand, I forced myself to close the software and take a break, letting luck settle before trading again.
After my principal became solid, I changed to a “combination punch”: quick in and out for short trades, regular investments to anchor the trend, while waiting for a big market surge with spare money.
Regardless of the size of the trade, I must set fixed profit and stop-loss points. This is the rein that holds back desire; how many people make money by luck, only to lose it all due to lack of planning, ultimately succumbing to emotions.

Some say contracts are a magic to get rich, but I know that it has never been so. It is merely a magnifying glass that precisely amplifies your judgment; if right, you reap abundantly, if wrong, you face total ruin.
On this journey, I have no secrets, just four strict rules I stick to:
1. Never go all in – always leave yourself a way out;
2. Every trade must have a stop-loss – lock the risk within a controllable range;
3. No more than three trades a day – refuse to trade fatigued, stay clear-headed;
4. Withdraw profits promptly – turn numbers into tangible security.
Over the years, I have seen too many myths of "getting rich overnight" and too many tragic scenarios of "going back to zero". Those who ride the wave by luck will eventually fall apart due to greed. The reason I can go from 1000U to where I am today is simply because I have more determination than others – be ruthless in market judgment and even more so with my desires. #BTC #ETH

The technical rebound under the continuation of the bearish pattern at the daily level of Bitcoin, after two consecutive bullish candles, the bullish momentum weakens, and the short-term pullback demand is prominent, currently oscillating around the 86000-88000 range.

The 4-hour RSI enters the overbought zone and then crosses downward, with bullish volume gradually weakening; the MACD runs parallel below the zero axis, with insufficient bullish momentum. After the MACD crosses downward at the 1-hour level, bearish volume increases, but the downward volume decreases simultaneously, indicating a probability of a weak rebound followed by another pullback in the short term.

The upper pressure focuses around 89600, and the lower support looks at around 85000.

Direction:
Bitcoin pulling back to the 85800-86300 range, target 88000, looking up to 90000.
Ethereum pulling back to the 2820-2870 range, target take profit 2950, looking up to 3100.

If Bitcoin falls below the 85000 support, then stop loss in a timely manner, wait for the low point to stabilize before re-entering.

Personal advice for reference only, not an investment recommendation! #BTC #ETH
